package.name: omni_cpp
package.description: omni-robot (design.md 4.9): the robot's always-on glue nodes in C++, on the robot computer: mcu_link (the MCU link, its frames compiled from the firmware's own protocol.h), mode_manager, scan_prep and heading_node; and the catch path's catch_perception and catch_behavior. The Python cores the sim still imports stay the reference (test/test_cores.py runs both on the same inputs). Each is also an rclcpp component.
